artworks.title: Saints Peter and Paul
artworks.medium: etching and engraving  on laid paper [working proof]
artworks.dimensions:
image: 39.4 × 27.2 cm (15 1/2 × 10 11/16 in.)
sheet: 40.2 × 28.2 cm (15 13/16 × 11 1/8 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures. The figure on the left is seated, resting his head on his hand, gazing to his left. He has curly hair and a short beard, wearing draped robes. The figure seems to be leaning against a structure beside a crack in a wall. The figure on the right stands, faces the seated figure, has medium-length curly hair and a full beard. He holds a book close to his chest with both hands and wears a long robe with a draped cloak over his shoulder. In the background, there is a landscape with trees, buildings, and a dynamic sky.

artworks.title: Torello Saraina
artworks.medium: woodcut [proof] on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund
artworks.description: The image is a profile portrait showing the upper half of a man's body in a seated position. He is facing to the right with his arms crossed or placed in front of his chest. His facial features are detailed with deep-set eyes, a pronounced nose, and distinct cheekbones. His hair appears short and textured. His expression is calm. He is wearing a garment that drapes over his shoulders, indicated by the folds and lines on the fabric. There is no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background of the portrait is a plain, dark surface that highlights the contours and textures of the man's face and clothing. The border of the image is simple and rectangular, enclosing the artwork.

artworks.title: The Steps of a House at Mousehole, Cornwall
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Joseph F. McCrindle Endowment Fund
artworks.description: This is a painting of a rustic stone building with exterior staircases and weathered walls. The scene depicts an old structure with a series of stone steps leading up to an entrance of an upper dwelling. The building's walls show signs of aging, with a textured surface. A railing accompanies the staircase for support. In the background, another flight of steps is visible, leading downwards alongside a rough-textured stone wall. Architectural elements such as windows and a chimney add charm to the composition.

artworks.title: Head of a Spanish Monk
artworks.medium: watercolor and chalk over graphite, heightened with gouache, on buff wove paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Joseph F. McCrindle Endowment Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the chest up. He is positioned frontally with a slight turn of the head towards the viewer's right. The man has a rugged, aged appearance with prominent cheekbones, deep-set eyes, and a long, bushy beard. He has a full head of gray hair, unkempt beneath a dark hood. The clothing suggests a cloak or robe, with soft, earthy tones and folds drawn on the paper. The sketch is done in graphite and colored pencil, including reds and blues in the garment folds. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Democritus in Meditation
artworks.artist: Gabriel Ehinger, after Johann Heinrich Schönfeld
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring various objects and scenes symbolizing the theme of vanitas. The scene includes a seated figure, a barren landscape, skeletal remains, a skull, and other symbolic objects. An inscription at the bottom reads "Vanitas vanitatum et omnia vanitas." A barren tree arches over the central composition, while a figure stands headless on the left. The composition uses a monochromatic palette and intricate lines, typical of the etching technique. The landscape and symbolic imagery evoke a sense of reflection on mortality.

artworks.title: The Three Maries at the Tomb with the Angel of the Resurrection
artworks.medium: miniature in tempera on leaf 1 of an antiphonal fragment on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: This is a painting of an illuminated manuscript page with music notation and a decorative initial. The illumination includes a scene surrounded by floral and geometric patterns. The scene is within an initial letter on a blue background with golden embellishments, depicting figures. The border is detailed with curls, leaves, and mythical creatures in blues, reds, and golds. The right side contains lines of musical notation on four-line staves, alongside text in calligraphic script.

artworks.title: Leaf 1 from an antiphonal fragment (verso)
artworks.medium: red and brown ink with decorated initial in red and blue on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a medieval music manuscript page. The manuscript consists of neumes on a four-line staff in red ink. The text is written in a Latin script with black ink, featuring letters of varying sizes. The lines of lyrics are interspersed with the musical notations. A decorative initial "A" in a blue and red outlined box with ornate detailing is visible.

artworks.title: Leaf 2 from an antiphonal fragment
artworks.medium: red and brown ink with decorated initials in red and blue on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a medieval manuscript page featuring musical notation and text on parchment. The page displays a Latin chant, with Gothic-style black text and neumatic musical notation on a series of horizontal red lines. The illustrations include decorative initials in shades of blue and red, some of which are adorned with flourish detailing. The notes appear as diamond and square-shaped neumes, typical of Gregorian chant notation.

artworks.title: Leaf 2 from an antiphonal fragment (verso)
artworks.medium: red and brown ink with decorated initials in red and blue on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a page from a medieval music manuscript. The page is covered with neumes, an early form of musical notation, positioned on red horizontal lines that provide reference for pitch. These neumes appear as small squarish and diamond shapes with small dashes, predominantly in black ink. The text is written in Latin script, also in black, with larger letters beginning certain lines or phrases. The first letter of the major lines is ornate, embellished with intricate decorations in red and blue ink. The page has a worn, parchment quality with a few visible stains. The layout and style suggest it is a piece of Gregorian chant, a form of plainchant used in medieval Christian liturgical music. The page has an antiquated and historic charm, representative of its cultural and historical context in religious and musical practices.

artworks.title: Leaf 3 from an antiphonal fragment
artworks.medium: red and brown ink with decorated initial in tempera on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a medieval musical manuscript. The image shows a page from an illuminated manuscript containing neumatic notation. The notations are written on horizontal red lines, with the lyrics and instructions written in black and red ink. The page features an ornate capital letter "N," embellished with intricate detailing in shades of blue and orange. The manuscript consists of Latin text, likely part of a religious or liturgical chant, and the overall design indicates it may have been used in a monastic or ecclesiastical setting for choral singing. The color and style of the manuscript are typical of medieval European manuscripts.

artworks.title: Leaf 3 from an antiphonal fragment (verso)
artworks.medium: red and brown ink with decorated initials in red and blue on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: The image depicts a parchment page from a medieval manuscript. It displays musical notation along with Latin text written in a clear Gothic script. The page features a five-line red staff for the musical notation, represented by square neumes in black ink. Some initial letters are ornately decorated with red and blue illumination. Red markings are present on the page, likely indicating verses or musical pauses. The overall appearance is typical of illuminated manuscripts from the medieval period.

artworks.title: Leaf 4 from an antiphonal fragment
artworks.medium: red and brown ink with decorated initials in red and blue on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a page from a medieval music manuscript. The page features musical notations on a five-line staff with square notation for Gregorian chant. The notes are in dark ink, and the staff lines are in red ink. The text between the notations is in Latin with a blackletter script. Large decorative initials in blue and red with intricate designs extend into the surrounding space. The manuscript is on vellum or parchment, giving a sense of antiquity and classical artistry associated with religious music.

artworks.title: Leaf 4 from an antiphonal fragment (verso)
artworks.medium: red and brown ink with decorated initials in red and blue on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a page from a medieval musical manuscript. The page shows music notation with square notes on four-line staves using the neumatic notation system. The accompanying text is in Latin with elaborate initial letters and intricate decoration in red and blue. The manuscript showcases the craftsmanship of medieval scribes on aged parchment paper, providing insights into historical musical and cultural practices.

artworks.title: Leaf 5 from an antiphonal fragment
artworks.medium: red and brown ink with decorated initials in red and blue on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a page from a medieval music manuscript. The page contains neumatic notations set on a series of four red lines that form a staff. The text accompanying the music is written in Latin using a Gothic style script. Some of the letters are decorated with colorful flourishes in red and blue ink. Red ink is also used for some of the text, marking it as different from the main body of black text. The paper appears aged, with visible wear and some small holes on the page.

artworks.title: Leaf 6 from an antiphonal fragment
artworks.medium: red and brown ink with decorated initial in tempera and initials in red and blue on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: This is an image of a medieval illuminated manuscript page with musical notation. The page features neumes on a four-line staff, written in Latin in a decorative Gothic script. The page includes ornate initial letters embellished with gold and blue designs, as well as red musical lines and black text with red notation. The parchment appears well-preserved.

artworks.title: Leaf 6 from an antiphonal fragment (verso)
artworks.medium: red and brown ink with decorated initials in red and blue on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a page from a medieval manuscript. The page displays a piece of Gregorian chant with Latin text and musical notation. It features a hand-drawn initial letter in red and blue ink on a parchment-like background, typical of illuminated manuscripts. The text is written in a formal, gothic script. The musical notation consists of square notes on a four-line staff. The embellishments add an artistic element to the text.

artworks.title: Leaf 7 from an antiphonal fragment
artworks.medium: red and brown ink with decorated initials in red and blue on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a medieval manuscript page displaying musical notation and text. The manuscript features a series of horizontal red lines forming staves on which square black notes are placed. The text, written in Latin, is in a decorative medieval script with several lines in black ink and some in red ink. At the beginning of some lines, elaborate illuminated initials are used, with one in blue and red with intricate detailing. The page’s material appears to be vellum, highlighted by subtle aging and natural texture visible in the photograph. The composition suggests this is a page from a liturgical book, possibly used for Gregorian chant or another form of medieval sacred music.

artworks.title: Isaac Sending Esau Out to Hunt
artworks.medium: miniature in tempera on leaf 7 (verso) of an antiphonal fragment on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: This is a painting of an illuminated manuscript page with musical notation and a decorative initial in the style of medieval manuscript illumination. The page includes Gregorian chant notation with block neumes on a staff with red lines, accompanied by Latin text in black and red ink. There is a large decorated initial 'Q' in red and blue in the lower left corner, filled with scrollwork and a miniature scene of two figures, one with a halo. The page is embellished with decorative elements such as elongated tendrils, and the vellum has an aged appearance.

artworks.title: Leaf 8 from an antiphonal fragment
artworks.medium: red and brown ink with decorated initial in red and blue on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an illuminated manuscript page with medieval musical notation. The image shows a page from a medieval manuscript featuring lines of musical notation written on a parchment. The page is divided into several staves by horizontal red lines, with black square notes above fragments of Latin text. The text is in a Gothic script and is minimally adorned with a decorative initial combining red and blue ink with a swirling design. The page has a worn appearance and a slightly yellowed hue. The layout suggests that this document was used for liturgical purposes, reading and singing hymns.

artworks.title: Leaf 8 from an antiphonal fragment (verso)
artworks.medium: red and brown ink with decorated initial in red and blue on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a page from an illuminated Gregorian chant manuscript. The page has a series of horizontal red lines that serve as a musical staff, with square black musical notes above. The text is in Latin script, interspersed with the notes. There is an elaborate initial letter 'R' with blue and red detailing. The parchment appears old with discoloration and wear.

artworks.title: Chester Beach
artworks.medium: platinum print
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting and facing slightly to the side. His left arm is bent at the elbow, and he is holding a knife in his hand. He has a thoughtful expression, a mustache, and short, slightly curly hair. He is wearing a light-colored long-sleeve shirt with rolled-up sleeves. The background is an out-of-focus, textured surface.

artworks.title: Plate Number 670. Ox; walking
artworks.medium: collotype
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This is a series of sequential frames showing a bull walking. The frames capture the bull's movement from the left to the right side of the frame. The top row displays the lateral movement, while the bottom row offers a front view of the bull's walking motion.

artworks.title: Plate Number 674. Sow; walking
artworks.medium: collotype
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a pig walking. The image consists of a series of black-and-white frames showing the motion of the pig walking along a fenced area. The top two rows display the pig from a side view, with its limbs in different positions as it walks. The bottom row shows a rear view, focusing on the movement of its body and legs. A grid-like fence in the background provides structure, and each frame is numbered.

artworks.title: Plate Number 444. Two models shaking hands and kissing each other
artworks.medium: collotype
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
